title: World Liquor 0.1.144 — graphical HUD performance pairing
native_evidence_scope: Dependency-only pairing with graphical HUD ignored-state pruning and bounded shaker preview caching. World Liquor gameplay and assets preserved; no client latency claim.
public_notes_inline:
同步酒館與燒烤的圖形 HUD 裁剪，以及酒館未變雪克杯預覽的有界快取。世界名酒只更新配對版本，保留玩法、存檔資料與素材。

實際客戶端延遲與效能仍待確認。
